description: Set pp_role in csr_attributes.yaml (the agent's csr_attributes setting, by default /etc/puppetlabs/puppet/csr_attributes.yaml) so the node's CSR embeds it, keeping the rest of an existing file

pp_role.description: Value to embed as the pp_role certificate extension (e.g. openvox_compiler): letters, digits and _ . : -, starting with a letter or digit
